title: Transport of the pre-pushforward classical localization triangle
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient datum of [def-pur-conventions], with $A=A_{E,n}$. Work with ordinary sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaf $A$ on the small etale and pro-etale sites and their ordinary derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Write $
u_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}	o T_{\mathrm{et}}$ for [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], and $D^+$ for objects with cohomology vanishing sufficiently far below. Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion of separated finite-type $k$-schemes, with quasi-compact complementary open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. For $B\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ put $D=i_{\mathrm{supp}}^	imes B$, using the ordinary etale closed-support right adjoint of [lem-exc-closed-support-triangle], and assume $D\in D^+(Z_{\mathrm{et}},A)$. Put $K=
u_X^*B$ and $L=
u_Z^*D$. Exact comparison inverse image and the canonical direct-image comparisons of [sk-thm-pe-direct-image-comparison] identify the $
u_X^*$-image of the entire etale triangle
$$i_*D\xrightarrow{\epsilon_{\mathrm{et}}}B\xrightarrow{\eta_{j,\mathrm{et}}}Rj_{\mathrm{et},*}j_{\mathrm{et}}^*B\xrightarrow{b_{\mathrm{et}}}(i_*D)[1]$$
with a natural distinguished triangle [def-weil-triangulated-category]
$$i_*L\xrightarrow{\epsilon'}K\xrightarrow{\eta_j}Rj_*j^*K\xrightarrow{b'}(i_*L)[1].$$
The first arrow is the transported etale closed counit, the second arrow is the actual pro-etale open adjunction unit, and $b'$ is the transport of $b_{\mathrm{et}}$ with the canonical shift comparison. The identifications are natural in $B$, and use the canonical mate comparisons for $i$ and $j$, together with $j^*
u_X^*\cong
u_U^*j_{\mathrm{et}}^*$; in particular they specify the sign of the third arrow.

source.place: First localization triangle before Rp_*; finite direct-image transport (old item Step 3)

proof.text: The coefficient ring is finite by Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing. Closed and open immersions are monomorphisms and therefore quasi-separated; the closed immersion is quasi-compact and the open immersion is quasi-compact by hypothesis. Hence the specified canonical direct-image mates for both morphisms are isomorphisms.

Use the existing rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility, whose inverse identifies the unbounded etale direct image on each D+ input with the included D+ direct image. Compose its image under comparison inverse image with the included canonical mate; this is exactly classicalLocalizationDirectImageMap. Its invertibility and naturality follow by composition. The exact inverse-image functors restrict literally to D+, so no extra choice of bounded-below models is needed.

Choose the natural boundary delta from exists_etale_closedSupportTriangle. Apply the triangulated exact comparison functor to each distinguished component; its third arrow is the image of delta followed by the canonical shift comparison.

Set alpha to asIso of classicalLocalizationDirectImageMap on the support object. Set gamma to asIso of the same map on the etale open pullback, followed by the included direct image of the inverse pullback comparison. This gives exactly the two specified equations for their homs.

The bounded-below etale adjunction is defined by restriction of the unbounded adjunction. Mathlib map_restrictFullyFaithful_unit_app, together with the existing equality of the two unbounded etale derived adjunctions, identifies the unbounded unit followed by rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility.inv with the included D+ unit. Apply comparison inverse image and then directImageMateCompatibility. The pullback comparison and its inverse cancel, proving that the transported second arrow is the actual pro-etale unit.

Use Triangle.isoMk with components alpha inverse, identity, and gamma inverse from the proposed transported triangle to the mapped etale triangle. Its first square is cancellation, its second square is the preceding unit identity, and its last square cancels the shifted alpha hom with shifted alpha inverse. Isomorphism invariance of distinguished triangles proves the asserted triangle with exactly the displayed boundary, without rotation or a sign change.

For an admissible morphism f, fullness of the D+ inclusion gives the morphism between support objects. Naturality of classicalLocalizationDirectImageMap proves the alpha equation. Its naturality on the open pullbacks, followed by naturality of the inverse pullback comparison, proves the gamma equation. Cancel gamma to get its inverse naturality. Substitute the displayed boundary formula and successively use this inverse naturality, naturality of delta, naturality of the canonical shift comparison, and the shifted alpha equation. These are exactly the final three required equations.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q82-e28b41852 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item in full: no new nodes and the statement is unchanged. Before reading I checked that the item is not on the side-live route-pivot drop list, is still unsplit on live, and has no re-split note. Sources read: sk-prop-a1 proof (opening localization triangle before Rp_*), sk-thm-pe-direct-image-comparison proof (mate built from the D^+ adjunction, iso for qcqs g, Stacks 03Q6/09A6), Stacks 015F, 06XW/070J and proetale 09BM. Coefficients are ordinary constant A_{E,n}-modules on both sites, matching lem-exc-closed-support-triangle and the comparison theorem. Checked: qcqs of i and j (affine, monomorphism); exactness of i_* on both sites; termwise = derived; D^+ preservation; the mate unit identity, including the orientation of c; all three squares of the triangle isomorphism with TR1, so b' has an explicit sign; naturality by conjugation; edge cases Z=∅, U=∅, B=0. One fault (E5/C2), repaired: the source triangle lem-exc-closed-support-triangle uses the total unbounded Rj_* and its unit, while the comparison theorem and lem-pe-direct-image-mate-compatibility use the D^+ functor R^+j_*, and the delivery identified the two silently. I added elementary Step 3: bounded-below injective complexes are K-injective (lem-weil-pbc-dplus-injective-representative, prop-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions-exist) and K-injectives compute the total Rj_* (lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-total-derived), so Rj_* preserves D^+; D^+ is full, so uniqueness of adjoints gives a unique μ:R^+j_*≅Rj_*|D^+ with μη^+=η. I threaded μ through γ, the unit computation and naturality, renumbered the step references, recomputed proof_deps and declared the two generic K-injective tools in tool_uses. Declared tool uses accepted. Not duplicates: lem-weil-finite-duality-closed-comparison and the sibling lem-pur-closed-finite-adjoint-counit-transport.
